arguments.summary: A privilege escalation attack originating from host 10.0.5.14 (WS-FIN-042) successfully exploited a PrintNightmare variant (CVE-2025-31337) to gain SYSTEM-level access on endpoint 10.0.7.33 (WS-IT-101). Forensic analysis confirmed the creation of a Golden Ticket using the krbtgt hash, indicating domain-level credential compromise. Immediate containment actions included emergency rotation of the krbtgt account, blocking of the attacker's source IP, full endpoint scanning, and system hardening via automated playbook execution.
